title: ONE SPACE manifest entry
description: Contract for every shared file under models/, data/, artifacts/. A manifest is a JSON object: { "files": [ <entry>, ... ] }, one entry per file, append-only. Readers cite (path, sha256); nothing crosses benches without an entry.

source.description: exact fetch command or URL (mirror allowed: HF, ModelScope, OSS), or 'produced'

script.description: for produced artifacts: the command that recomputes this exact file

upstream.description: upstream hash if the bytes are mirrored (e.g. original HF revision sha)

model.description: model identifier this file belongs to, for cross-referencing views of the SAME weights
